slave 1 replied to "Read Discrete Inputs": 8 bit states, 2 ON / 6 OFF (details below)

── Data details ──
10001 = ON
10002 = OFF
10003 = ON
10004 = OFF
10005 = OFF
10006 = OFF
10007 = OFF
10008 = OFF
Note: the response frame carries no start address or quantity; numbering starts at 10001 by default and the last byte may contain padding bits — refer to the matching request

── Byte-by-byte ──
00 01  Transaction identifier  Sequence number 0x0001 assigned by the master to this exchange; the response echoes it
00 00  Protocol identifier     0x0000 = standard Modbus protocol
00 04  Length                  4 more bytes follow (unit identifier + data)
01     Unit identifier         slave address: device 1
02     Function code           0x02 = Read Discrete Inputs
01     Byte count              1 data bytes
05     Data                    each bit is the state of one discrete input (LSB first within each byte)

── Technical details ──
Transport: Modbus TCP (10 bytes total)
Transaction ID: 0x0001
Protocol ID: 0x0000
Length field: 4 (4 bytes actually follow)
Unit ID: 1
Function: 0x02 (Read Discrete Inputs)
Byte count: 1
Data: 05
PDU: 02 01 05
